description: This file provides a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that converts raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels, handling null/undefined inputs, replacing underscores/hyphens with spaces, collapsing multiple spaces, and converting to Title Case while preserving apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code into a human-readable label, handling various formatting rules and fallback for null/empty inputs.
